content: परि(री)हारः .²1 Leaving, quitting, giving up, abandoning. .²2 Removing, taking away; as in विरोधपरिहार; तेषां गुप्तिपरीहारैः कच्चित्ते भरणं कृतम् <ls>Rām. 2. 100. 48</ls>. .²3 Shunning, avoiding. .²4 Refuting, repelling. .²5 Omitting to mention, omission, leaving out. .²6 Reserve, concealment. .²7 A tract of common land round a village or town; धनुःशतं परीहारो ग्रामस्य स्यात् समन्ततः <ls>Ms. 8. 237</ls>. .²8 A special grant, immunity, privilege, exemption from taxes; प्रदद्यात् परिहारांश्च <ls>Ms. 7. 201</ls>; अनुग्रहपरिहारौ चैभ्यः कोशवृद्धिकरौ दद्यात् <ls>Kau. A. 2. 1. 19</ls>. Hence ˚लेखः a writ of remission as a favour; तथा परीहारनिसृष्टिलेखौ <ls>Kau. A. 2. 10. 28</ls>; <ab>cf.</ab> जाते विशेषेषु परेषु चैव, ग्रामेषु देशेषु च तेषु तेषु . अनुग्रहो यो नृपतेर्निदेशात्, तज्ज्ञः परीहार इति व्यवस्येत् .. <ls>Kau. A. 2. 10. 28</ls>. .²9 Contempt, disrespect .²10 An objection. .²11 Seizing, keeping back. .²12 Bounty. .²13 (In <ab>gram.</ab>) The repetition of a word before and after इति; <ab>cf.</ab> परिग्रह. .²14 (In <ab>dram.</ab>) Atoning for any improper action.
